notes_short: Left edge of material straddling the trench matches is inset, ever so slightly, from Si0 bridge across the trench.  Right side of material shows a different behavior, where material is located on perfect line on top of trench edges.
Upper portion of defect is falling in to comparator and shows a line exactly where it falls over the edge.

Material defect lying in between two comparators is cut sharply on top edge of one comparator and extends, ever so slightly into the upper comparator with a contrast line in the material matching where the upper comparator (lower) edge should be.

Two of three separate material defects occlude two different comparators.  One slightly shows lines inset on top of SiO extension into comparator and other shows extension into comparator with contrast line matching expected comparator boundary.
